newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close firmer, trend seen upward.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close firmer, trend seen upward.

text.p: Austrian shares ended marginally higher on firm volumes on Thursday, with further short-term gains seen, traders said.
"I see the market as positive," one trader said, noting the ATX index of 21 blue chips had found firm footing above 1,100 points. The next target is seen at 1,120.
"There're good vibes in the market at the moment," said another. Trade was becoming broader and less dominated by selective buying, dealers noted.
Buying interest was particularly strong in regional utility EVN, oil and chemicals group OMV and Vienna airport operator Flughafen.
The ATX index inched up 2.49 points or 0.23 percent to 1,108.14. Among its constituents 10 shares rose, 10 fell and one remained unchanged.
The session's leading gainer regional utility EVN jumped 1.49 percent to 1,570 schillings.
The leading decliner was Austria Mikro Systeme (AMS), losing 2.05 percent to 812 schillings.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index climbed 0.54 points or 0.13 percent to 420.82.
The December ATX future edged down 0.2 points to 1,109 on turnover of 188 contracts. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
